summary: Delete a Time and Material Attachment
description: Deleting a Time and Material Attachment from a specified Project

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the Time & Material attachment.

id.description: Unique identifier of the Time & Material entry attachment.

attachment_id.description: Identifier of the underlying stored file for this attachment.

content_type.description: MIME type of the attached file (e.g., image/jpeg, application/pdf).

presentation_url.description: Publicly accessible URL for viewing the attached file in a browser.

url.description: Direct download URL for the attached file.

thumbnail_url.description: URL for a thumbnail preview of the attached file.

filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded attachment.
